<description>
Part of #36833

This PR adds local tracking of recent stale tips for [BIP 332](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0332.md).
The feature is behind a new `-staletips=<mode>` option (default `none`). There is no P2P change yet: with `-staletips=headers` the node only tracks tips.

### Key changes

* A new `AcceptedStaleTip` validation notification feeds the staletips tracker.
* The tracker is built from the block index at startup, keeping the tips with the most work.
  *  At most 10 tips are tracked. When the tracker is full, a new tip evicts the one with the least work, but only if the new tip has more work.
* `getchaintips` RPC updates
  * Add new options `max_depth` and `staletips_only`
  * Report `fork_point` for each non-active tip.

Test networks get the stricter policies the BIP recommends:
* **signet:** only tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per block.
* **testnet3/4:** only tips with a difficulty of at least about 1,000,000.

Sample output (regtest, after a reorg replaced the tip at height 111)

```
$ bitcoin-cli getchaintips
[
  {
    "height": 112,
    "hash": "544a1c7f23c96990e2db9f4415f498d1ee61effac8e7416ec53fb91f538b2d2c",
    "branchlen": 0,
    "status": "active"
  },
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]

$ bitcoin-cli -named getchaintips staletips_only=true
[
  {
    "height": 111,
    "hash": "3a0797803400d80abdbf34f73df33f760c1e24696531746f975e3041055b6967",
    "branchlen": 1,
    "fork_point": "43765e057b6cde12df1701595d90ae51cf80490fef1343edd2d3fbe2edf3958e",
    "status": "valid-fork"
  }
]
```
</description>
